frozen: Written and committed before any run. Run once; not edited after it has been run. A change makes a new version, and this version's first result stands as reported.
held_out: Not used by the learning loop, the curriculum or as recipe examples. The stack is scored on a copy of its saved recipes with learning switched off.
reference: Computed in clinical_core/agere/tiered/proof.py in Python, without the stack's SQL or recipes. A hospital stay is counted once (rows that repeat, overlap or continue one stay are one stay); a readmission is an inpatient stay beginning 1 to 30 days after an earlier discharge; spend is payer paid amounts on claims that count in metrics; care gaps follow the simplified rules stated in the care-gap recipes.
scoring: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong. An unanswerable question that is answered counts as wrong. Two phrasings per question, three runs each, all runs reported.
